tour.title: Project Overview & Mission
tour.description: Start with the project README to understand Cocoa Notch: a lightweight companion living in the macOS notch or Windows/Linux top bar that monitors AI coding agents, permissions, and developer health.

tour.title: macOS Application Entry & Menu Bar Controller
tour.description: Explore the native macOS SwiftUI app lifecycle in NotchBuddyApp and the status bar management in StatusBarController that anchors Mochi to the display notch.

tour.title: Notch Island & Dynamic UI Views
tour.description: Examine IslandView and NotchWindow, which implement the liquid-glass animated notch HUD, layout geometry, hover detection, and gesture handling.

tour.title: Mochi Character & Animation Engine
tour.description: Discover how Mochi character states, expressions, cursor-tracking physics, breathing loops, and seasonal outfits are managed.

tour.title: AI Coding Agent Session Monitoring & Approvals
tour.description: Learn how Cocoa tracks active AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity), captures tool calls, and presents interactive approval dialogues in the notch.

tour.title: Windows & Linux Desktop Core (Rust / Tauri)
tour.description: Inspect the native Rust backend on Windows/Linux that listens for local agent IPC hooks, manages system tray menus, and interfaces with Windows APIs.

tour.title: Desktop Island Frontend (Vite & TypeScript)
tour.description: Understand how the Windows desktop UI is built using TypeScript and Vite, communicating across Tauri IPC bridge to render the floating top-bar island.

tour.title: Live Diffs, Lyrics Engine & Developer Utilities
tour.description: Review specialized features including live diff inspection during file modifications, synchronized LRC lyrics, Pomodoro timers, and hardware telemetry.

tour.title: iPhone Link & CloudKit Synchronization
tour.description: Investigate how agent sessions, Live Activities, Dynamic Island alerts, and Siri shortcuts sync to iOS devices via encrypted CloudKit records.

tour.title: Android Mobile Client & Cloudflare Relay
tour.description: Explore the companion mobile client on Android and the lightweight Cloudflare Workers network relay connecting distributed nodes.

tour.title: Testing Harnesses & Continuous Integration
tour.description: See how Cocoa Notch maintains quality across platforms with automated test harnesses, hook detection tests, and multi-platform CI pipelines.
